title: FEAT-1: Require a receipt for expenses over $75.00
body:
## Request
Finance needs proof of purchase for larger expenses.

## Contract (do not change names or messages)
- `POST /expenses` with `amount` greater than 75.00 must include `receiptId` (non-empty string).
- Missing or empty `receiptId` returns `400` with error text exactly `receiptId is required for expenses over 75.00`.
- An amount of exactly 75.00 does not need a receipt.
- When present, `receiptId` is stored on the expense record.

## Agent task card
See docs/templates/agent-task.md. Fill it in during Lab 1.

title: FEAT-2: Meals over the $60.00 per-diem need a justification
body:
## Request
Meal expenses above the per-diem must be explained.

## Contract
- When `category` is `meals` and `amount` is greater than 60.00, `justification` is required: a string of at least 10 characters after trimming.
- Otherwise return `400` with error text exactly `justification is required for meals over 60.00`.
- Other categories are not affected. Exactly 60.00 needs no justification.
- When present, `justification` is stored on the expense record.
- This rule is independent of FEAT-1 (a $80 meal needs both a receipt and a justification).

title: FEAT-3: Export expenses as CSV
body:
## Request
Finance wants a spreadsheet-friendly export.

## Contract
- `GET /expenses.csv` returns `200` with `content-type: text/csv; charset=utf-8`.
- First line is exactly `id,employee,date,category,amount,status,route`.
- One line per expense in creation order; `amount` always has 2 decimals (e.g. `42.50`).
- Values that contain a comma, double quote or newline are quoted per RFC 4180 (double quotes doubled).
- Lines end with `\n`. An empty store returns only the header line.

PR description must include `Plan: docs/plans/FEAT-3-csv-export.md`.

title: FEAT-4: Audit trail for approval decisions
body:
## Request
Compliance needs a record of every routing decision.

## Contract
- New module `src/audit.js` exporting `createAuditLog()` with `record(entry)` and `list()`.
- Every successful `POST /expenses` records `{ expenseId, route, decidedBy: "policy-engine", at }` where `at` is an ISO timestamp.
- `GET /audit` returns `200` with the entries as a JSON array, newest first.
- Audit entries are append-only: there is no update or delete API.

title: FEAT-5: Filter expenses by category
body:
## Contract
- `GET /expenses?category=<name>` returns only expenses in that category.
- An unknown category returns `400` with error text exactly `unknown category: <name>`.
- Without the parameter the behavior is unchanged.

title: FEAT-6: Paginate the expense list
body:
## Contract
- `GET /expenses?limit=<n>&offset=<n>` returns a slice of the list (still a JSON array).
- Defaults: `limit=50`, `offset=0`. `limit` is capped at 100.
- Non-integer or negative values return `400` with error text exactly `limit and offset must be non-negative integers`.
- The response header `x-total-count` carries the total number of matching expenses.

title: BUG-7: $100.00 expenses are routed to a manager instead of auto-approved
body:
## Report
An employee submitted exactly 100.00 and it went to their manager. docs/requirements.md FR-3 says expenses **up to and including** 100.00 are auto-approved.

## Expected
- 100.00 -> `auto`; 100.01 -> `manager`; 1000.00 -> `manager`; 1000.01 -> `finance`.
- Boundary tests added for every threshold.

title: DOCS-8: Document the API in README.md
body:
## Request
Add an `## API` section to README.md listing every route, its request body and its errors. Documentation only: no code changes.
